title: Venezuelan-Style Stir Fry with Tofu
description: A Chinese-inspired stir fry made with crispy tofu, crunchy vegetables, and a hint of Venezuelan flair. This dish is perfect for a quick and easy dinner.

ingredients.name: tofu
ingredients.notes: extra-firm, drained and cut into bite-sized pieces

ingredients.name: salad
ingredients.notes: chopped mix of lettuce, cabbage, and carrots

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of veggie oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the tofu and cook for 3-4 minutes, until golden brown and crispy.
Add the chopped salad and cook for 2-3 minutes, until wilted.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, ground ginger, and 1 tablespoon of water.
Pour the sauce over the tofu and salad mixture, and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the stir-fry to a serving platter, garnish with chopped green onions, and serve immediately.
Serve hot, garnished with additional green onions if desired.
